The '''Murkwater Depths''' are a sub-location of the [[Moonglade Marsh]].

{{ZoneText|Discover the lake and its secrets!|Hunt all living creatures!}}

== Features ==
The '''Murkwater Depths''' is a large pond that stretches into several tunnels and locations. It is meant for {{Skill|Fishing}} and {{Skill|Hunting}}, most notably [[Hunting#Water Hunting|Water Hunts]], and houses several mobs that can be hunted with a [[Fishing Net]].

=== Ancient Ruins ===
{{Main|Ancient Ruins}}
The {{zone|Ancient Ruins}} serve as an entrance to the {{zone|Forest Temple}}.

=== Forest Temple ===
{{Main|Forest Temple}}
The {{zone|Forest Temple}} can be accessed by activating all the lanterns in the {{zone|Ancient Ruins}}. Donating {{c}} and {{Item|Enchanted Fig Log}}s to the {{zone|Forest Temple}} for bonuses.

=== Reefguard Pass ===
{{Main|Reefguard Pass}}
The {{zone|Reefguard Pass}} is a path to the {{zone|Drowned Reliquary}}.

=== Drowned Reliquary ===
{{Main|Drowned Reliquary}}
The {{zone|Drowned Reliquary}} contains {{MobSprite|Tidetot;Tidetots}}, {{MobSprite|Seacurse;Seacurses}}, and {{MobSprite|Hydrospear;Hydrospears}}.

=== Squid Cave ===
{{Main|Squid Cave}}
The {{zone|Squid Cave}} contains {{MobSprite|Lumisquid;Lumisquids}}.

=== Dragon's Lair ===
{{Main|Dragon's Lair (Galatea)}}
The {{zone|Dragon's Lair (Galatea)}} houses the [[Jade Dragon]], which allows the player to purchase a {{Item|Jade Dragon Pet}}.

=== Dive-Ember Pass ===
{{Main|Dive-Ember Pass}}
The {{zone|Dive-Ember Pass}} acts as a path to the {{Zone|Stride-Ember Fissure}}.
